title: Campsites Near Keflavík Airport (KEF) for Your First or Last Night (2026)
description: Campsites near Keflavík Airport for a campervan's first or last night in Iceland: Sandgerði, Garðskagi, Vogar, Happy Campsite and Reykjavík, with 2026 prices, winter status and facilities. Every fact sourced.

intro.value: Airport Camping in Sandgerði puts itself 8 minutes from Keflavík International Airport, and Happy Campsite Keflavík says it is 6 minutes away. Both are on the Reykjanes Peninsula, together with Garðskagi and Vogar. Reykjavík Eco-Campsite is the capital-area alternative.

In winter, Sandgerði, Garðskagi and Vogar are listed as open all year (for Sandgerði, Parka.is's dates start on 9 January, so ring ahead in deep winter). Happy Campsite Keflavík's season is 1 May – 1 October.

scope_note: Scope: campsites on the Reykjanes Peninsula near Keflavík Airport, plus Reykjavík Eco-Campsite. Grindavík is not included because tjalda.is said on 2026-10-24 that 2026 information from the operator is still awaited.
table_caption: Closest to the airport first, per the operators' own drive-time claims where given. Prices are 2026 rates as published.

items.value: You need showers and laundry: Sandgerði lists showers, washing machine and dryer, and water-tank refill.
Cheapest listed adult rate: Garðskagi at 1,700 ISK, but it is low-service: 24-hour toilets, a dump point and electricity, and no showers or indoor space.
You want a kitchen: Vogar lists a kitchen, showers and free WiFi.
You are picking up or returning a Happy Campers van: Happy Campsite is next to their office (season 1 May – 1 October). Book electricity in advance; there are only a few connections.
You want the city: Reykjavík Eco-Campsite is open all year (only Area A in winter), with a guest kitchen.

tips.value: Sandgerði: tjalda.is says reservations are not possible except for large groups, so just turn up.
Happy Campsite: late-night arrival is possible only if you pre-booked on the Parka app.
Garðskagi: pay at Röstin restaurant during opening hours, or online at parka.is/gardskagi.

warning: Seasons, prices and facilities can change at short notice. Contact the campsite before relying on it, especially in winter.
